question: Is any undeclared sibling of an admitted ordinary owner a Core-representable effect whose omission changes an executable value versus Trinity, making CSA-K-04 LIVE rather than a catalog-contract inconsistency?
why_unknown: Census of clean-owner raw-2 damage spells: dropped siblings are Dummy 3 (58), aura 33 slow (40), knock back 98 (31), aura 4, teleport 252, script 77, area trigger 179, summon 28 - none has a Core state representation, and the host alone decides which implemented siblings to declare. The track probe asserts acceptance plus the declared damage, which equals the consumer value.
reopen: A host-resolver contract that requires every implemented sibling to be declared, or a real admitted owner whose undeclared implemented sibling (e.g. Energize, ApplyAura of an implemented subtype) Core silently drops.
